prompt: Create one polished 3D children's calendar-button illustration of Memoping from Catch! Teenieping, based on the character printed on the provided toy-package reference. The package is only a character reference; draw the character alone, no packaging. Memoping has pale buttery-yellow fur, huge turquoise eyes, a white belly, red-and-blonde wing-shaped hair with curled blonde fringe and braided side pigtails tied with turquoise ornaments, and a red collar. Friendly smile, front-facing. She holds her turquoise magic diary OPEN in front of her chest, clearly presenting both ivory pages toward the viewer, and holds her small blue-and-yellow pen. The open diary is the dominant foreground object, about 65% of the illustration width and 40% of its height, with thick teal cover edges, a central fold and a few simple turquoise ruled lines/page boxes that read as a planner at small button size. No readable words or numbers. Keep her recognizable face and hair above the diary. Compact head-and-body icon with small feet visible below, centered, all hair and props fully within the square with 8% empty padding. Soft rounded glossy animated materials matching the show, crisp bold silhouette, readable at 40 to 64 pixels. Transparent background, real RGBA alpha outside the character and diary; opaque white eyes and pages. No scenery, framing, ground plane, text, logos or extra characters.
